visual_scope.accepted_production_scope_quote: Kaedah kiraan 46 → 41 diterima sebagai skop produksi.
visual_scope.obligations_are_not_assets: 46 obligations resolve to 8 asset groups and a PROPOSED 41 unique assets. The numbers differ in both directions: 5 obligations are discharged by a composite another obligation already pays for and 3 grouping headings need no asset at all, while the D-05 diagram redraw and the Slide 2 scenario need 3 assets that belong to no obligation. 46 was never a production figure.

precedence_rule.rule: Where the instructional and production lenses conflict, the instructional decision governs and the assets are not merged.
precedence_rule.authority_quote: Di mana dua sudut bertembung (jika ada): keputusan instruksional mengatasi pengoptimuman produksi.
precedence_rule.binding_on: every subsequent T04 asset merge or reuse decision

do_not_reuse_items.label: Pengurusan Stok dan Penyimpanan (Baja)
do_not_reuse_items.visual_difference: Penyimpanan baja (kering, selamat, jauh dari air) berbeza daripada penyimpanan racun (berkunci, berlabel, berpengudaraan).
do_not_reuse_items.instructional_ground: Learners must not confuse the two PPE sets or the two storage regimes; a shared visual would blur a distinction the learner is expected to make.
do_not_reuse_items.production_ground: The two visuals differ substantially in content, so a shared asset would not in fact save production effort.

do_not_reuse_items.label: Keselamatan Pekerja (Baja)
do_not_reuse_items.visual_difference: PPE untuk baja (sarung tangan, topeng muka) berbeza daripada PPE untuk racun (topeng pernafasan, cermin mata, sarung tangan kimia, sut pelindung).
do_not_reuse_items.instructional_ground: Learners must not confuse the two PPE sets or the two storage regimes; a shared visual would blur a distinction the learner is expected to make.
do_not_reuse_items.production_ground: The two visuals differ substantially in content, so a shared asset would not in fact save production effort.
